### How this work is cited

Passages inside The Analects are identified by book and chapter (e.g. lunyu 4.15). The Analects is a compiled record of sayings, not a work by Confucius. The common formula 'Confucius said' refers to a tradent whose words were assembled by later hands, and the book-and-chapter locator is what makes a passage findable in any edition.

### The work in Confucius’s thought

Confucius (Kong Qiu, 551–479 BCE) taught in the late Spring and Autumn period amid the Zhou order’s political fragmentation. Born in the state of Lu, he briefly held local office and then spent years seeking rulers who would adopt ritual-based, virtue-centered government. [More on Confucius](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/confucius) .
